name: TRL makes AMD GPUs officially supported, with the full test suite on MI300X
title: TRL makes AMD GPUs officially supported, with the full test suite on MI300X
summary: Hugging Face's TRL post-training library now officially supports AMD GPUs and runs its whole test suite on MI300X for every pull request, so fine-tuning and RL recipes are tested on AMD hardware rather than working by accident.
